items.title: 69% Upside for Affirm? Citi Thinks So, and Here’s How
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAffirm is down 23% from its July high after a quarter of fast growth and higher late payments. Citi kept its Buy rating and its $115 target, 69% above today’s price.

items.title: Rising costs will not halt data center construction boom, Citi says
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi told clients in a note Wednesday that data center construction is getting more expensive after the midterm elections, but it does not expect the boom to end, as demand for AI computing power remains strong.

items.title: VSE (VSEC) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.summary: The updated narrative on VSE centers on a modest trim to its fair value estimate, which has shifted from about US$257.11 to roughly US$247.67. Analysts link this adjustment to a more cautious stance on valuation and the next leg of growth, even as they point to strong recent execution and a healthier margin profile. As you read on, you will see how these moving pieces fit together and how to track the evolving VSE story over time. Analyst Price Targets don't always capture the full story...
